data.define: Used for things with a beautiful, matching look.

misuse.text: Don't call your messy room 'aesthetic' to Mom.
misuse.why: It only fits stylish, pretty things.

data.l1_hook: तुम्हारा कमरा Pinterest जैसा दिख रहा है! aesthetic
data.l1_ex: तुम्हारी डेस्क बहुत aesthetic लग रही है।

native.tip: “aesthetic” = सौंदर्यपूर्ण. उदाहरण: “Your desk looks so aesthetic.”
